pairs.why: Nearly identical wheels; B has a slightly softer rim highlight and less of a polished-statue streak than A.
A shows more scratchy wood grain on the rim, while B's wood is smoother and closer to the clean, soft finish of the real cards.
A's rim has more visible grain lines, and B's smoother wood matches the real cards' not-ultra-smooth finish better.
A has more drawn-in grain texture on the rim, and B reads smoother and cleaner, like the real cards.
A's leather is smoother and cleaner with a soft sheen, while B has a slightly grainier, more textured leather surface.
A's boots have clean, smooth leather and spurs that attach with a proper strap, and B has a bit more surface texture.
